text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Hi, Trainer. Let's have a good session.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well... I gave a student that was reading
comics in
class a warning today.
choice_data_list: なんかいつもより元気が……
choice_data_list_en: You seem less energetic than usual...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But then she started crying. I guess I was
too loud
and I scared her... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If I can't consider other people's
feelings, I'm not
fit to be head of the
disciplinary committee... I'm
so ashamed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is feeling down after

unintentionally upsetting another
student.
